Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Imagine finding hope, even when life throws you curveballs you never saw coming. That's what this journey is all about: discovering how resilience and the way we see the world can help us face the unexpected with courage.
In Always Looking Up: The Adventures of an Incurable Optimist, Michael J. Fox invites us into his story—a story where optimism isn't just a feel-good word, but a lifeline in the midst of personal trials, like living with Parkinson’s disease.
Together, we're going to explore how attitude—not just circumstances—shapes the quality of our lives. And you'll see how humor, gratitude, and faith become powerful tools for navigating all that uncertainty.
What if optimism isn't about ignoring the tough stuff, but about choosing to focus on what's possible, even in the face of hardship? We'll walk through themes of family, work, faith, and activism, uncovering how each one offers strength when we need it most.
So, how do you keep looking up, even when the world feels heavy? Let's find out—together.
